_note: Supply-chain build allowlist (#3795, epic #2433). With `npm_config_ignore_scripts=true` the default for every fleet install, lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall) never run — the Shai-Hulud execution vector is closed. These packages are the trusted exceptions whose native build IS legit: after `npm install`, `bsc-build-allowed` runs `npm rebuild <pkg>` for exactly the ones PRESENT under ./node_modules, with scripts re-enabled for that one invocation. Nothing off this list ever runs a script. Add a package here only when its native build is genuinely required and the package is trusted; the list is embedded at build time (data/permissions/build-allowlist.json) and baked into the bsc-env helper.
